QuestInfo.name: Pulse Disruptor 3 - Pantheon
QuestInfo.2: The #t4033665# has been installed in #m400000000#. You had to fib to Cartalion a little bit to get away with it. Two left. Return to base for now and take the Promessa to #bHenesys#k for the next installation.
QuestInfo.0: Install one of the #t4033665# devices in\r\n#m400000000#.
QuestInfo.1: Install a #t4033665# in #m400000000#. You have been told that it would be best to install the apparatus near a person named #bCartalion#k.

no.0: Gelimer's people seem capable of getting to you anywhere. It'd be prudent to install a device in Pantheon, just to be safe.
